sports.body: An Indian national, Harmanveer Singh, was arrested in California for alleged drug trafficking.  He is linked to a Canada-based organized crime group led by Ravinder Dhanda.  This arrest is part of a larger international law enforcement operation targeting crime syndicates.  Authorities charged thirty-seven individuals under "Operation Hard Ball" across multiple countries.  Another Indian national, Nitish Kaushal, was also arrested while attempting to cross into Canada.

Yashvir achieved a personal best throw on his final attempt to claim the medal.  Chopra expressed happiness at sharing the podium with another Indian athlete.  This silver medal adds to Chopra's extensive collection of career achievements.

sports.title: CWG 2026 Day 9 medal table: India’s standing after historic six-medal day
sports.body: India enjoyed their best day of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, winning six medals to take their tally to 23. Harsh Singh and Asmita Dey claimed historic judo golds, Neeraj Chopra secured javelin silver, Yash Vir Singh won bronze, Tejaswin Shankar earned India's first decathlon medal, and Yamini Mourya added judo silver as India closed on ninth-placed Wales.

city.body: Indian-American philanthropists are making significant contributions to American universities this year. Anil Kochhar and his wife Marilyn paid the education loans for graduating students at North Carolina State University. Jyoti and Nishi Bhatia established an endowment for graduate fellowships at the University of Texas. This fellowship will support students with expanded resources and financial aid. The Bhatias hope their contribution will inspire future generosity among recipients.
